scope: Five unranked named leads and forty unsent questions. Retained modern-reference identities do not admit a governed field candidate, authenticate a historical core or authorize fieldwork. Uppåkra/Lund is not equated with Gullåkra or Vesums mossar.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Identify the exact physical lake/core or archaeological study parcel, native identifiers, source version and coordinates; distinguish modern registry, deposited pollen sequence and archaeological site.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Source custodian and qualified lake/core or archaeological identity reviewer
questions.reopening_condition: A dated, source-bound identity packet names the intended physical study object and resolves aliases without treating geographic proximity as core identity.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Provide dated bathymetry or parcel stratigraphy, sediment/archive condition and the exact proposed sampling point/footprint; identify which observations support a coring or archaeological sampling design.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Qualified field investigator and bathymetry/sediment or archaeological archive custodian
questions.reopening_condition: A dated measured packet identifies the archive and proposed footprint; a qualified field reviewer records support and remaining uncertainty for that design.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Document the proposed approach, launch/entry location, transport and access conditions, evidence date and who can authorize that access.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Local access custodian and field logistics lead
questions.reopening_condition: A dated site-specific access record identifies the route, current conditions, responsible authority and any unresolved restrictions.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Identify the current land/water or collection custodian for the actual footprint and provide the scope, date and evidence of any permission required for the proposed activity.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Land/water or collection custodian and responsible project investigator
questions.reopening_condition: The actual rights-holder and footprint are established and a dated permission decision covers the named activity; permission is not inferred from public map availability.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Determine which permits, notifications or other approvals apply to the exact proposed activity and location, who decides them, and the status and conditions of each.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Competent permitting authority and responsible project investigator
questions.reopening_condition: The competent authority provides a dated applicability/decision record tied to the footprint and activity; unresolved approvals remain explicit.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Determine the current conservation, protected-area and cultural-heritage constraints relevant to the exact footprint and activity, using authoritative dated records and a qualified interpretation.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Competent conservation and cultural-heritage authorities
questions.reopening_condition: Authoritative current constraints and their relevance to the proposed activity are recorded, including remaining restrictions and decisions; absence is not inferred from an unchecked map.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Provide a site-specific field risk assessment for the proposed date, transport and sampling method, identifying water/ground/weather hazards, emergency arrangements and the accountable field lead.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Qualified field safety lead and relevant local site custodian
questions.reopening_condition: A dated activity-specific assessment and operating decision identifies controls, emergency arrangements and remaining hazards before fieldwork is scheduled.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.

questions.requested_fact: Finjasjön: Return a qualified advance, defer or reject decision for the exact source-bound field proposal, with rationale, conditions, scientific objective and permissions/safety dependencies.
questions.responsible_external_resolver: Responsible scientific field lead with the relevant domain and permission reviewers
questions.reopening_condition: A dated signed or otherwise verifiable decision addresses this exact footprint and activity, names the evidence inspected and preserves every unmet condition; it does not imply ecological validation.
questions.scope_limit: Preparation only; this unanswered question supplies no access, permission, safe-fieldwork, scientific-admission or ranked-candidate decision.
